headline: Delta Corp shares surge nearly 20% to near 52-week high
hook: Sharpest single-day rally in months for Delta Corp
summary: Delta Corp shares jumped 19.33% to reach Rs 87.44 during the afternoon trading session. The stock emerged as one of the top gainers on the Bombay Stock Exchange. Retail investors holding the gaming and hospitality stock saw a significant single-session wealth expansion.
why_it_matters: Sudden volatility spikes short-term gains for existing Delta Corp holders
winners_losers: Delta Corp holders gain / short sellers hurt
